description: This Java source file defines the CdyneServices class, which provides a service to interact with the CDyne address lookup API, specifically to retrieve city and state information based on a ZIP code. It includes methods for calling the external web service, parsing XML responses, and handling errors.

classes.name: CdyneServices
classes.description: Provides static methods to call the CDyne address lookup web service and process responses.
